title: feat(audit): validate intra-repo markdown link anchors in audit-docs
body:
## Background

The 2026-07-28 audit found ~20 dead anchors/references that
`audit-docs.mjs --check` cannot see: the tool validates mirror-pair
byte equality and file-set membership, but never resolves a relative
markdown link's target file or its `#fragment` against the target's
actual headings. The recurring defect class (a heading rename
orphaning every inbound anchor, a template link to an unshipped
file) is mechanical and preventable — the same "everything the audit
doesn't check has drifted" pattern this repository already fixed for
mirror content.

## Proposed change

1. Add an anchor-validation pass to `src/scripts/audit-docs.mts`
   (or a sibling module it invokes): for every markdown file in the
   audited sets, resolve relative links; fail when the target file
   does not exist, and when a `#fragment` does not match any
   GitHub-slugged heading in the target (implement the GitHub
   slugger rules: lowercase, spaces to hyphens, punctuation/em-dash
   removal, duplicate-suffixing).
2. Scope: `docs/**`, `idd-template/**`, `.github/instructions/**`,
   `skills/**`, root-level markdown. External `http(s)` URLs are out
   of scope (no network I/O). Support a narrowly-used inline
   suppression comment for intentional exceptions, and document it
   in `audit/README.md`.
3. Validate template links in *template context*: a link from an
   `idd-template/` file must resolve against the shipped template
   tree, not the source repo tree (this is what let the
   copilot-instructions.md and schemas/ links rot).
4. Wire the pass into the existing `--check` output/remediation
   format and the same CI lane that runs audit-docs today.
5. Add unit tests with fixture files covering: valid anchor, renamed
   heading, em-dash slugging, missing target file,
   template-context-only miss, and a suppressed exception.

Blocked by the dead-reference sweep issue in this roadmap: landing
the checker first would turn CI red on the ~20 known-broken links.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` fails on a markdown link
      whose relative target or fragment does not resolve, with a
      remediation message naming the file, line, and target.
- [ ] Template-context resolution catches links from
      `idd-template/**` to files the template does not ship.
- [ ] The em-dash/punctuation slugging cases from the audit (the
      `#a3--…` family) are covered by tests.
- [ ] The full current tree passes the new check (after the sweep
      issue lands).
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes; generated `scripts/*.mjs` matches
      `pnpm run build` output.

Blocked by #1696

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented._
